motivation: Frozen cell-transition diagnosis found one source's changed bilinear cell dominating slope reversals at all six viewed budget states
data_role: already viewed development; C1 interpolatory inverse-depth comparison
interpolation: Tensor Catmull-Rom cubic on inverse axial Z using a4x4 stencil, exact projective derivative, no integer snapping; interpolatory at grid points and C1 across jointly qualified neighboring cells
domain: Same front/image bounds; require all16 depths0.3..5m and normals squared norm>0.25. Every one of nine overlapping2x2 subpatches must satisfy the original0.05+0.01*minimum-depth continuity bound. Positive finite interpolated inverse depth; no clipping or bilinear fallback
initial_population: Start from the unchanged original sampling-domain population including its geometric matching and nine-probe bilinear stencil. Filter once for cubic center support and retain factors with at least200 sources; preserve original source identities and bilinear center normalizers. Report actual retained factors/sources
fixed_objective: Freeze this initial population and original metric normalizers for the entire attempt; evaluate cubic residuals and derivatives with the same incoming nonlinear prior and Huber0.01m weight. No source dropout, new normalization or geometric reselection during fitting
unchanged_solver: Original thirty-correction GN solver,21 Armijo candidates1..2^-20 and numerical slack, current support, SPD condition<=1e6, full proposal<=0.1m/0.15rad and strict full-proposal1e-5m/1e-5rad convergence; no damping
independent_verification: Separate Hermite interpolation with central endpoint slopes, homogeneous projection, SVD normals, original-population selection, incidence/prior matrices, spectral solve, Rodrigues search and independent endpoint audits; old bilinear control verified separately
analytic_controls: Quadratic inverse-depth reproduction, exact integer values, C1 left/right derivatives, XYZ finite differences, invalid16-corner support, rendered local fits, nonzero-prior12-axis objective gradients and report corruptions
followup_eligibility_rule: Both cases must converge all five cubic windows, improve original-discrete fresh convergence, have no local/fresh guards, pass all original0.03m RMS gates and have median original-discrete fresh RMS no worse than deep-search control
scope: Local interpolation/objective/domain comparison, not a solver-only change; no new trajectory fitting, numeric real GT, physical scoring, tracker/prior/Schur commits, default/native-Rust adoption or timing claim
